02 / The daily ritual

Three steps.
One signature look.

A little clay. A few deliberate moves.
Make your morning routine your own.

01

Warm it up.

Start with a small amount. Rub between your palms to spread it evenly before applying.

02

Work it through.

Distribute through dry or towel-dried hair, working from the back towards the front.

03

Make it yours.

Shape with your fingers for texture, or use a comb for definition. Add a little more only if needed.

The essentials

A few things to know.

What finish does the hair clay give?

Man Made Volumizing Hair Clay has a matte finish and medium hold, as shown on the product label.

How much should I use?

Start with a small amount, spread it between your palms and work it through your hair. Build gradually to suit your length and style. Follow the directions on your product packaging.
